final: WITH film_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM film_counts), above_overall AS (SELECT fc.film_id, fc.actor_count, fc.actor_count - o.mean_count AS excess FROM film_counts AS fc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND fc.actor_count > o.mean_count), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS mean_count FROM above_overall), final_rows AS (SELECT a.actor_count, a.excess, a.actor_count - m.mean_count AS second_excess FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_avg AS m WHERE m.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND a.actor_count > m.mean_count) SELECT SUM(actor_count), AVG(excess), AVG(second_excess) FROM final_rows
